top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs the two achievements I can defend on evidence: base editing credited to Liu, who conceived and directed both the cytosine and adenine editor programmes (a defined deaminase reaction made programmable at one nucleotide without a double-strand break, independently reproduced and in patients), and general ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N coupling for Buchwald and Hartwig, whose mechanism is established by isolated intermediates and three decades of independent use. Three laureates in all; the parts differ in maturity, so if the committee must drop one, P002 is my fallback and then P004. The lipid-nanoparticle trio (P003) has delivered consequences but the attribution is contested, and I would rather award a part than no prize.
